stem: ----, the new product became a great success.

options.A: So that customers could not afford it
options.B: Although it was launched without much advertising
options.C: Before it will be launched in other countries next month
options.D: Unless it is advertised on television
options.E: Because nobody wanted to buy it at such a high price

solution: Az reklamla piyasaya sürülmesine karşın başarılı olması karşıtlıktır; 'Although' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The bridge was closed to traffic for repairs, ----.

options.A: so drivers had to take a much longer route
options.B: so drivers could cross it much more quickly than before
options.C: unless drivers will pay a higher toll to use it
options.D: although it urgently needed repairs to its supports
options.E: because drivers had to take a longer route home

solution: Köprünün kapanmasının sonucu sürücülerin uzun yol kullanmasıdır. 'Because' aynı bilgiyi neden gibi sunar ve neden-sonuç ilişkisini ters çevirir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Ever since online shopping became popular, ----.

options.A: people will prefer to visit physical stores
options.B: many small shops in city centres have had to close
options.C: the first website was created in the early 1990s
options.D: customers were paying with cash only
options.E: delivery companies hire more drivers next year

solution: 'Ever since + geçmiş' yapısı, o andan bugüne süren durumu anlatır; ana cümle Present Perfect olmalıdır: 'have had to close'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The company's profits fell sharply last year, ----.

options.A: which will be announced last week
options.B: although demand for its products fell in all its markets
options.C: mainly due to a large increase in raw material costs
options.D: mainly because its costs decreased considerably during the year
options.E: so it paid higher dividends than ever before

solution: Kârın düşmesinin nedeni hammadde maliyetlerindeki artıştır; 'due to + isim öbeği' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The museum was closed for renovation last month; ----.

options.A: in contrast, the renovation will start next year
options.B: similarly, its entrance fee is quite low
options.C: therefore, the school trip had to be postponed
options.D: otherwise, the paintings will be moved to another city
options.E: for example, it attracts thousands of visitors every year

solution: Müzenin kapalı olması gezinin ertelenmesinin nedenidir; sonuç bildiren 'therefore' ile kurulan seçenek anlamca uyar. Diğer bağlayıcılar (örnek, karşıtlık, benzerlik) ilişkiyi bozar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, the government decided to raise the minimum wage.

options.A: When the economy will grow faster than expected next year
options.B: So that all prices in the country would fall immediately
options.C: Unless workers demand higher salaries
options.D: If inflation had been lower
options.E: As the cost of living had risen sharply

solution: Asgari ücretin artırılmasının nedeni hayat pahalılığının artmasıdır; geçmişte önceki olayı veren 'As ... had risen' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: If I had known about the traffic jam, ----.

options.A: I would have taken the metro instead
options.B: I take the metro to work on most days
options.C: I would take the metro to work every single day
options.D: I will take the metro to work tomorrow morning
options.E: I had taken the metro to work that morning

solution: Üçüncü tip koşul ('If + Past Perfect') ana cümlede 'would have + V3' ister: 'I would have taken the metro'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Since the new manager took over the department, ----.

options.A: productivity increased by 25 percent in 2010
options.B: productivity had been decreasing for many years before that
options.C: productivity will increase next year
options.D: productivity has increased by nearly 25 percent
options.E: productivity was increasing steadily even before he came

solution: 'Since + geçmiş' yan cümlesi ana cümlede Present Perfect ister: 'has increased'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The factory was built near the river ----.

options.A: although it needed large amounts of water
options.B: because the river had dried up completely
options.C: unless the city council allows it
options.D: so that the river will be polluted
options.E: so that it could use the water for its cooling systems

solution: Fabrikanın nehir kenarına kurulmasının amacı suyu kullanmaktır; amaç bildiren 'so that ... could' zaman ve anlamca uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, it is difficult to make accurate predictions about the economy.

options.A: Unless the economy had been stable
options.B: Since predictions are correct in most cases
options.C: Because all economic factors are easy to measure and control
options.D: As there are so many factors that can change suddenly
options.E: So that economists can work more easily and earn higher salaries

solution: Tahmin yapmanın zorluğunun nedeni birden değişebilecek çok sayıda etkendir; diğer seçenekler bu zorlukla çelişir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Small companies often find it hard to compete with large ones, ----.

options.A: unless large companies had closed
options.B: since they can buy materials more cheaply than large firms
options.C: although they usually have fewer resources and fewer employees
options.D: so large companies often close their factories in small towns
options.E: since they cannot buy materials in bulk at low prices

solution: Küçük firmaların zorlanmasının nedeni büyük miktarda ucuz alım yapamamalarıdır; diğer seçenekler bu nedenle çelişir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: If the government reduces the tax on fuel, ----.

options.A: tax revenues were higher than expected
options.B: many drivers had already sold their cars
options.C: transport costs for many businesses will fall
options.D: transport costs would have fallen last year
options.E: the price of bread rose sharply in 2010

solution: Birinci tip koşul ('If + Simple Present') ana cümlede 'will + yalın fiil' ister: 'transport costs ... will fall'. Diğerleri zaman bakımından uyumsuzdur.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Many people now prefer to work from home, ----.

options.A: since it saves them the time they would spend commuting
options.B: although it saves them a lot of the time they would spend in traffic
options.C: even if their internet connection is fast
options.D: so that their offices in the city centre were larger and quieter
options.E: while the first computers were very large

solution: Evden çalışmanın tercih edilme nedeni yol süresinden tasarruftur; neden bildiren 'since' uygundur. 'Although' aynı bilgiyi karşıtlık gibi sunar ve mantığı bozar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Although he had studied accounting for four years, ----.

options.A: he graduated with excellent grades
options.B: he had never prepared a real set of financial statements
options.C: he had learned a great many accounting rules and standards at university
options.D: he found a job in a large accounting firm very easily after graduating
options.E: he knew a great deal about financial statements

solution: 'Although' karşıtlık ister: dört yıl muhasebe okumasına karşın gerçek bir tablo hazırlamamıştır. Diğerleri eğitimle uyumlu sonuçlardır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The longer the meeting continued, ----.

options.A: the participants have become tired
options.B: and so the participants gradually became more tired
options.C: the most tired were the participants
options.D: the more tired the participants became
options.E: the participants became more tired

solution: 'The + karşılaştırma ..., the + karşılaştırma ...' kalıbının ikinci yarısı da 'the more ...' ile başlar: 'the more tired the participants became'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Unless the company improves the quality of its products, ----.

options.A: it has won several international awards for design
options.B: its customers will be very satisfied
options.C: it would have opened a new factory
options.D: it will lose many of its loyal customers
options.E: its sales increased by 10 percent last year

solution: 'Unless' (-medikçe) olumsuz bir sonuç bekletir: kaliteyi artırmazsa müşteri kaybedecektir. Zaman olarak da 'will + yalın fiil' gerekir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Not only did the new manager reduce costs, ----.

options.A: and she was criticised for wasting money
options.B: so the costs went up considerably
options.C: but she also increased the company's market share
options.D: although profits had already fallen
options.E: but she will be replaced next year

solution: 'Not only ...' ile başlayan devrik yapı 'but ... also' ile tamamlanır ve iki olumlu sonucu ekler: 'but she also increased ...'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Before you sign any contract, ----.

options.A: the contract had been cancelled
options.B: the lawyer reads it after you sign
options.C: you would have read it carefully
options.D: read every clause carefully
options.E: you signed it without reading it

solution: Zaman yan cümlesi ('Before you sign') bir öğütle (emir kipi) tamamlanır: imzalamadan önce her maddeyi dikkatle oku.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: When the central bank cut interest rates last year, ----.

options.A: many families took out loans to buy new homes
options.B: the banks are lending less money to small firms
options.C: loans became much more expensive for most families
options.D: many families will take out loans to buy new cars
options.E: many families have been saving more since then

solution: Faiz indirimi geçmişte borçlanmayı artırır; 'When + Simple Past' ile uyumlu, geçmiş zamanlı ve mantıklı sonuç 'took out loans'tır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The board meeting has been postponed ----.

options.A: because several board members are abroad this week
options.B: although none of the members can attend the meeting this week
options.C: because all the board members are available this week
options.D: so that the board members could not attend the meeting
options.E: unless the board members had been abroad on business trips

solution: Toplantının ertelenme nedeni üyelerin yurt dışında olmasıdır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The new phone sold out within hours, ----.

options.A: where people had waited outside the shops all night
options.B: which shows how much demand there was for it
options.C: who were waiting in long queues outside the shops
options.D: which shows that nobody was really interested in it
options.E: that it was much more expensive than older models

solution: Virgülden sonraki 'which' bütün cümleye gönderme yapar; birkaç saatte tükenmesi talebin büyüklüğünü gösterir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Had the company invested in new technology earlier, ----.

options.A: it will not lose any customers to its rivals next year
options.B: it does not lose customers to its competitors
options.C: it would not have lost so many customers
options.D: it had not lost customers
options.E: it has not lost any of its customers so far

solution: 'Had the company invested ...' devrik üçüncü tip koşuldur ('If the company had invested'); ana cümle 'would have + V3' ister.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The teacher spoke very slowly and clearly ----.

options.A: although the students needed help
options.B: unless the students ask her questions
options.C: so that all the foreign students could follow her
options.D: as soon as the lesson will finish
options.E: so that nobody could understand the lesson

solution: Yavaş ve açık konuşmanın amacı yabancı öğrencilerin anlayabilmesidir; 'so that ... could follow' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: If you need any further information, ----.

options.A: please do not hesitate to contact our office
options.B: you would have contacted our office
options.C: our office was closed yesterday afternoon
options.D: you had to contact our office before the deadline
options.E: we sent you an email with all the details last week

solution: Geniş zamanlı koşul cümlesi bir rica/öneri ile tamamlanabilir: 'please do not hesitate to contact ...'. Diğerleri geçmiş zamanlıdır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: In order to attract more foreign investors, ----.

options.A: the procedures will have been simplified last year
options.B: the government made it harder to set up a business
options.C: the government simplified the rules for starting a business
options.D: foreign investors have already left the country in large numbers
options.E: taxes on foreign companies were increased sharply for two years

solution: Amaç yabancı yatırımcı çekmektir; bunu sağlayan eylem iş kurma kurallarının kolaylaştırılmasıdır. 'In order to'nun öznesi ana cümlenin öznesiyle (hükûmet) aynı olmalıdır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The more you practise speaking English, ----.

options.A: more confident you became
options.B: you will gradually become more confident when speaking
options.C: the most confident you become
options.D: the more confident you will become
options.E: the less you will need to speak it in class

solution: 'The more ..., the more ...' kalıbının ikinci yarısı da 'the + karşılaştırma' ile başlar: 'the more confident you will become'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The report was written in a hurry; ----.

options.A: otherwise, it will be published tomorrow
options.B: for example, it was checked by three experts
options.C: in contrast, it was prepared very carefully
options.D: nevertheless, it had a few mistakes in the tables
options.E: consequently, it contained several calculation errors

solution: Aceleyle yazılmanın beklenen sonucu hatadır; 'consequently' uygundur. 'Nevertheless' beklenen sonucu karşıtlık gibi sunar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Online courses have become very popular, ----.

options.A: so most universities stopped teaching students in classrooms
options.B: partly because students must attend them in person
options.C: partly because students can study at their own pace
options.D: although students can study whenever and wherever they like
options.E: unless the internet had been invented

solution: Çevrim içi derslerin yaygınlaşmasının nedeni öğrencinin kendi hızında ilerleyebilmesidir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Even though she had no previous experience in sales, ----.

options.A: she found the job very difficult during her first few months
options.B: she soon became the top seller in her team
options.C: the company did not offer her the job after the interview
options.D: she made many mistakes in her first month
options.E: she needed some training before starting

solution: 'Even though' karşıtlık ister: deneyimsiz olmasına karşın kısa sürede ekibin en çok satış yapanı olmuştur. Diğerleri deneyimsizlikle uyumlu sonuçlardır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Our flight was cancelled because of the storm, ----.

options.A: so we arrived at our destination earlier than planned
options.B: although the weather at the airport was terrible all day
options.C: so we had to spend the night at the airport hotel
options.D: unless the storm will stop before midnight tonight
options.E: where we were planning to spend our summer holiday

solution: Uçuşun iptalinin sonucu geceyi otelde geçirmektir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, the students had already left the classroom.

options.A: As soon as the teacher returns
options.B: When the teacher will return with the papers
options.C: By the time the teacher returned with the exam papers
options.D: Before the lesson starts tomorrow
options.E: While the teacher is preparing the exam

solution: Ana cümledeki Past Perfect ('had already left') başka bir geçmiş olaydan önce tamamlanmayı anlatır; 'By the time + Simple Past' gerekir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Companies must keep their accounting records for a certain period, ----.

options.A: so that the records could be destroyed immediately
options.B: because the tax office is not allowed to check them
options.C: although the tax office may ask to see them during an inspection
options.D: unless they had already been audited
options.E: so that the tax office can examine them if necessary

solution: Kayıtların saklanmasının amacı vergi dairesinin gerektiğinde incelemesidir; 'so that ... can' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, you will not be allowed to enter the exam hall.

options.A: Since you have your identity card
options.B: When you arrived at the exam building early in the morning
options.C: Although you bring your identity card and exam entry document
options.D: If you arrive after the exam has started
options.E: If you arrived on time yesterday

solution: Ana cümle gelecekteki bir yasağı anlatır; birinci tip koşul 'If + Simple Present' gerekir ve anlamca da geç kalmak giriş yasağının nedenidir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: As the population of the city grew rapidly, ----.

options.A: fewer people needed buses and other public transport services
options.B: the city will build new schools in the 1950s
options.C: the demand for housing and public services decreased dramatically
options.D: the city has been very quiet and empty
options.E: the demand for housing and public services increased

solution: Nüfus artışının doğal sonucu konut ve kamu hizmeti talebinin artmasıdır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, the shop owner decided to stay open until midnight.

options.A: Although the shop was full of customers waiting to pay
options.B: Since there were still many customers waiting inside
options.C: Unless more customers arrive
options.D: Because there were no customers left in the shop after nine o'clock
options.E: As soon as all the customers have gone

solution: Dükkânı gece yarısına kadar açık tutmanın nedeni içeride bekleyen müşterilerdir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The company has been losing money for three years, ----.

options.A: because its profits have been increasing every quarter
options.B: so the shareholders paid themselves record dividends this year
options.C: so the shareholders have decided to replace the management
options.D: although its sales have fallen dramatically
options.E: and it will celebrate its record profits with a big party

solution: Üç yıldır zarar etmenin mantıklı sonucu yönetimin değiştirilmesidir. Diğerleri zarar ile çelişir ya da ilişkiyi ters kurar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The company was fined by the authorities ----.

options.A: because it had paid all its taxes earlier than required
options.B: unless it pays its taxes
options.C: although it broke several rules
options.D: because it had not paid its taxes on time
options.E: so that it paid its taxes on time

solution: Para cezasının nedeni vergilerin zamanında ödenmemesidir; ceza olayından önceki eylem Past Perfect ile verilir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: When the auditors examined the warehouse, ----.

options.A: they found that some of the recorded goods were missing
options.B: the company is going to hire a new accountant
options.C: they will count all the items again
options.D: they find that everything is in order
options.E: they have been checking the cash book since morning

solution: 'When + Simple Past' yan cümlesi ana cümlede de geçmiş zaman ister: 'they found that ...'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: When interest rates are low, ----.

options.A: saving money in banks becomes much more profitable for families
options.B: people borrowed more in 1990
options.C: people tend to borrow more money to buy houses and cars
options.D: banks had refused to give loans
options.E: people tend to stop borrowing money and start saving instead

solution: Düşük faiz borçlanmayı cazip kılar; genel doğruyu geniş zamanla anlatan seçenek uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: While some experts believe that prices will continue to rise, ----.

options.A: others agree that prices will rise further in the coming months
options.B: the experts were invited to a conference
options.C: prices rose sharply in the previous year
options.D: others expect them to stabilise in the coming months
options.E: they also think prices will keep rising for a long time

solution: 'While' burada karşılaştırma/karşıtlık kurar; bazı uzmanların görüşüne karşıt görüş 'others expect them to stabilise'dir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The company did not meet its sales target this year; ----.

options.A: as a result, its customers were very satisfied
options.B: in other words, its sales exceeded all of the managers' expectations
options.C: therefore, it paid record bonuses to its sales staff
options.D: nevertheless, it managed to reduce its costs significantly
options.E: for example, it sold more products than ever before in its history

solution: Hedefi tutturamamakla maliyeti düşürebilmek arasında karşıtlık var; 'nevertheless' uyar. Diğerleri ilk cümleyle çelişir ya da ilgisiz sonuç kurar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Although electric cars are becoming more popular, ----.

options.A: more and more people are buying them every year
options.B: they produce no exhaust emissions while driving
options.C: their batteries have become cheaper in recent years
options.D: many governments support them with tax reductions
options.E: their high prices still prevent many people from buying them

solution: 'Although' karşıtlık ister: yaygınlaşmalarına rağmen yüksek fiyat almayı engellemektedir. Diğer seçenekler yaygınlaşmayı destekler, karşıtlık kurmaz.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Although the company's revenue increased by 20 percent last year, ----.

options.A: it will open two new stores in the coming spring
options.B: its net profit decreased because of rising financial expenses
options.C: many customers bought its products online
options.D: its sales team received large bonuses for the strong growth in revenue
options.E: the increase was mainly due to higher export sales in European markets

solution: 'Although' karşıtlık ister: gelir arttığı hâlde kârın düşmesi beklenenin tersidir. Diğer seçenekler gelir artışıyla uyumlu ya da ilgisiz bilgi verir, karşıtlık kurmaz.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: It was such a difficult exam ----.

options.A: that only a few students managed to finish it on time
options.B: so that only a few students could finish it
options.C: that most students finished it easily in less than half an hour
options.D: as only a few students managed to finish
options.E: than the students had expected

solution: 'Such ... that' kalıbı sonuç bildirir; sınavın zorluğuyla uyumlu sonuç az öğrencinin bitirebilmesidir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, the number of tourists visiting the city has doubled.

options.A: Although the airport attracted more airlines
options.B: When the new airport will be opened in the north of the city
options.C: Until the airport was closed last year
options.D: Since the new airport was opened five years ago
options.E: Unless the new airport is opened

solution: Ana cümle Present Perfect'tir ('has doubled'); başlangıç noktasını veren 'Since + geçmiş' gerekir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The company introduced flexible working hours; ----.

options.A: on the contrary, working hours remained exactly the same as before
options.B: otherwise, its employees had been happier
options.C: for instance, its competitors will do the same thing next year
options.D: as a result, employee satisfaction improved significantly
options.E: in other words, it closed several of its branches

solution: Esnek çalışma saatlerinin doğal sonucu çalışan memnuniyetinin artmasıdır; sonuç bildiren 'as a result' uyar. 'On the contrary' ilk cümleyle çelişir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: If the weather is good this weekend, ----.

options.A: we have been having picnics since May
options.B: we are going to have a picnic by the lake
options.C: we will stay at home because of the rain
options.D: we had a picnic by the lake last weekend
options.E: we would have had a picnic in the park with friends

solution: Gelecekle ilgili olası koşul gelecek zamanlı bir planla tamamlanır: 'we are going to have a picnic'.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The price of gold usually rises during times of crisis, ----.

options.A: as investors see it as a safe place for their savings
options.B: although nobody wants to buy it
options.C: but investors consider it a safe place to keep money
options.D: so the demand for gold falls dramatically
options.E: when the first coins were made in Lydia

solution: Kriz dönemlerinde altının yükselmesinin nedeni güvenli liman görülmesidir; neden bildiren 'as' uyar. 'But' karşıtlık kurar, ama iki bilgi çelişmez.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Even if the company receives the new investment, ----.

options.A: it would have needed much more money to survive
options.B: it will no longer need to worry about its costs
options.C: because it has enough cash in its bank accounts
options.D: it received the investment from foreign partners last year
options.E: it will still need to cut some of its costs

solution: 'Even if' (-se bile) koşul gerçekleşse de sonucun değişmeyeceğini anlatır: yatırım gelse bile maliyet kısmak gerekecektir. 'No longer need to worry' bu anlamla çelişir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Scientists have discovered a new species of fish in the Black Sea, ----.

options.A: whose was unknown before
options.B: which had not been recorded there before
options.C: that it lives in very deep water
options.D: who has lived in those cold waters for centuries
options.E: where had not been recorded by scientists before

solution: Virgülle ayrılan ilgi cümlesinde nesne/hayvan için 'which' kullanılır ve ardından fiil gelir; diğerleri yapıca bozuktur.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Many young people move to big cities, ----.

options.A: where there are more job opportunities
options.B: although there are more opportunities there
options.C: whose job opportunities are rather limited
options.D: who offers more jobs and better education
options.E: which there are more job and education opportunities

solution: Yer bildiren 'big cities' ardından tam cümle geldiği için 'where' gerekir; 'which/who' yapıca, 'although' anlamca uymaz.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: The new metro line will reduce traffic in the city centre, ----.

options.A: unless it has been opened in 2010
options.B: as many commuters will leave their cars at home
options.C: but fewer people will use public transport
options.D: so that more cars entered the city centre
options.E: since more people bought cars last year

solution: Trafiğin azalmasının nedeni insanların arabalarını evde bırakmasıdır; zaman olarak da gelecek uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Because the company's main warehouse was damaged in the flood, ----.

options.A: its sales reached a record level in the same month
options.B: deliveries to customers were delayed for several weeks
options.C: deliveries will be delayed if it rains heavily again next year
options.D: customers received their orders much earlier than usual
options.E: the warehouse has been built in 1998

solution: Depo hasarının doğal sonucu teslimatların gecikmesidir; geçmiş zamanlı sonuç cümlesi uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Some people prefer to shop at local markets, ----.

options.A: unless the local markets are open on Sundays and holidays
options.B: although the products there are often fresher and cheaper too
options.C: so the products there were bought online by most families
options.D: because the products there are much more expensive than in shops
options.E: as the products there are often fresher and cheaper

solution: Pazarı tercih etmenin nedeni ürünlerin taze ve ucuz olmasıdır; neden bildiren 'as' uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, the bank refused to give the company a loan.

options.A: Unless the firm submits its financial statements
options.B: Since the firm could not provide any collateral
options.C: As soon as the firm has paid back all of its old debts to other banks
options.D: If the manager had signed the loan documents a few weeks earlier
options.E: So that the firm could expand its production

solution: Ana cümle geçmişte bir reddi anlatır; nedenini veren 'Since the firm could not provide any collateral' anlam ve zaman bakımından uyar. 'If ... had signed' üçüncü tip koşuldur ve ana cümlede 'would have' ister.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: ----, he was able to pay off his student loan in just three years.

options.A: By saving a large part of his monthly salary
options.B: Although his parents supported him financially
options.C: Despite having a well-paid and secure job
options.D: Unless he finds a part-time job
options.E: Because he lost his job soon after graduating

solution: Borcunu üç yılda kapatabilmesinin yolu maaşının büyük kısmını biriktirmesidir. Diğerleri ya karşıtlık/neden ilişkisini ters kurar ya da zaman bakımından uymaz.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Unless we leave the office now, ----.

options.A: we will catch the last train easily
options.B: we missed the last train home yesterday evening
options.C: we would have caught the train
options.D: we are arriving home much earlier than usual
options.E: we will miss the last train home

solution: 'Unless' olumsuz bir sonuç bekletir: şimdi çıkmazsak son treni kaçıracağız.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Credit cards are convenient for shoppers; ----.

options.A: however, they can lead to serious debt if used carelessly
options.B: for example, they were invented in the 1950s
options.C: therefore, many banks refuse to issue them
options.D: similarly, cash is no longer accepted in shops
options.E: in addition, nobody uses them online

solution: Kolaylık ile borç riski arasında karşıtlık vardır; 'however' ile kurulan seçenek anlamca uyar.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Despite working long hours every day, ----.

options.A: she had to work at weekends too
options.B: she was very tired when she got home in the evenings
options.C: she earned a high salary
options.D: she finished all her tasks easily and went home early
options.E: she still could not finish her tasks on time

solution: 'Despite' karşıtlık ister: uzun saatler çalışmasına karşın işlerini yetiştirememiştir. Diğerleri uzun çalışmayla uyumlu sonuçlardır.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)

stem: Prices in the restaurant are quite high; ----.

options.A: in addition, it is the cheapest restaurant in town
options.B: therefore, university students eat there almost every day
options.C: in other words, it is very affordable
options.D: for instance, a main course costs very little compared with other places
options.E: on the other hand, the food and service are excellent

solution: Yüksek fiyatın karşısına olumlu bir özellik koyan 'on the other hand' uyar; diğerleri ilk cümleyle çelişir.

source.styleRef: SGS Yabancı Dil (gerçek sınav 28-30 cümle tamamlama profili)
